question: Find the display name of the owner of the highest-scoring child post (i.e., a post with a non-null ParentId) that was created by a user who has contributed to at least one post with 1,000 or more views and, across all their post history entries on such posts, used only one distinct type of post history.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE p."XCL_043" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."XCL_033" IN (
    SELECT ph."XCL_017"
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    JOIN posts AS p2 ON p2."XCL_026" = ph."XCL_014"
    WHERE p2."XCL_030" >= 1000
    GROUP BY ph."XCL_017"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph."XCL_013") = 1
  )
ORDER BY p."XCL_031" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE p."XCL_043" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."XCL_033" IN (
    SELECT ph."XCL_017"
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    JOIN posts AS p2 ON p2."XCL_026" = ph."XCL_014"
    WHERE p2."XCL_030" >= 1000
    GROUP BY ph."XCL_017"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph."XCL_013") = 1
  )
ORDER BY p."XCL_031" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE p."XCL_043" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."XCL_033" IN (
    SELECT ph."XCL_017"
    FROM postHistory AS ph
    JOIN posts AS p2 ON p2."XCL_026" = ph."XCL_014"

    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ph."XCL_013") = 1
  )
ORDER BY p."XCL_031" DESC
LIMIT 1
